title: Joe and the Forest on the Wall
synopsis: Joe thinks the backyard wall is only a wall, until a magnifying glass reveals a tiny green forest with a visitor walking through it.

related_resources.reason: Mosses can look like miniature plant landscapes through a hand lens and shelter small animals; this supports the factual setting.
The puppy’s repeated looking-again invites a child to anticipate what might be hidden in a familiar outdoor place.
